content.name: Marcus Bell
content.title: Digital Marketing Specialist
content.summary: Digital marketing specialist with nine years in paid search, paid social and marketing automation for healthcare, meal-kit and B2B software companies. Currently manages $1.1M in annual ad spend for a SaaS analytics firm and lowered cost per sales-qualified lead by 34% by connecting HubSpot pipeline data back into Google Ads bidding.

experience.title: Digital Marketing Specialist
bullets: Manage $1.1M a year across Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads and Capterra for a B2B analytics platform selling to mid-market finance teams.
Imported offline conversions from HubSpot deal stages into Google Ads, letting bidding target pipeline value and cutting cost per SQL from $412 to $272.
Built 14 lead-nurture workflows segmented by industry and trial behavior, raising trial-to-demo conversion from 9% to 15%.
Run A/B tests on demo-request pages in Unbounce every two weeks; the winning layout lifted form completion by 22%.
Train two marketing coordinators on campaign QA, UTM standards and Looker Studio reporting.

experience.title: SEM Specialist
bullets: Scaled paid search for a regional meal-kit subscription from $40,000 to $190,000 a month during 2020 demand growth while keeping CAC under $58.
Restructured 3,000+ keywords into tightly themed ad groups and added negative lists, raising Quality Scores and trimming CPC by 17%.
Launched the first Meta catalog ads for weekly menus, contributing 28% of new subscribers within a year.
Reported weekly on subscriber cohorts with the finance team so promo codes were cut back once payback periods exceeded four months.

experience.title: Digital Marketing Coordinator
bullets: Ran local search and Google Ads for 11 dental offices, booking an average of 420 new-patient appointments a month online.
Rewrote service pages for implants and orthodontics with clearer pricing FAQs, doubling organic leads to those pages in a year.
Set up call tracking with CallRail so office managers could hear and score how front-desk staff handled ad-driven calls.

achievements.title: Pipeline-based bidding
achievements.detail: First at the company to feed CRM deal stages into ad bidding, now the standard setup for all paid channels.

achievements.title: Peak-season scaling
achievements.detail: Grew monthly search spend almost fivefold in 2020 without breaking the CAC ceiling.

interests: Mentoring at a local coding bootcamp
